description.value: You become a blur or mirages of yourself, and soar towards a target within 60 ft at devastating speed without provoking attacks of opportunity, and make a melee attack against the target. The target is considered flat-footed to this attack. If successful, you deal damage as if you made 4 successful melee attacks. Any Sneak attack is only applied once. This attack ignores Damage reduction, and hardness equal to your Wisdom modifier, and is applied once.
